hooks.text: A medieval Silk Road city now sits submerged in a mountain lake.
How did a busy trade hub vanish beneath Lake Issyk-Kul?
Fourteen acres of ancient graves rest underwater in a high mountain lake.

title: Why Did This Silk Road City Sink Beneath Lake Issyk-Kul? 😳
description: Discover how a bustling medieval trade hub was swallowed by a massive earthquake and submerged in Lake Issyk-Kul over six centuries ago.
